youtube.aciklama: In an analysis of US data, every 10 decibels of hearing loss was associated with about 1.4 times higher odds of falling. One explanation is that orienting by environmental sounds and noticing warning sounds becomes harder; another is cognitive load, as listening effort can draw attention away from balance. These studies are cross-sectional, and whether hearing aid use reduces falls is not yet known for certain.
